message.content: On September 20, 2026, at 16:00, LiHua and Thane Chambers discussed their favorite first-person shooter games. According to the conversation, LiHua mentioned he was particularly into "Call of Duty: Warzone," which is a popular battle royale-style multiplayer video game. LiHua highlighted the strategic elements of the game, like planning an approach and working with teammates, as well as the adrenaline rush experienced during final rounds.
